| [7 · The bridge link](07-bridge-link.html) | why two-body estimators have infinite variance in the charge basis, and the bridge link that removes it: construction, code, validation; perylene results, and the multi-slice bridge that also sees nodes away from the bridge slice |

Everything described here is on branch `newMeasurements`.

## Why the work was done in this order

1. **Get the model right.** The existing `PPPGaugeAction` had bugs and was never used; the production
   driver used the spin basis, which cannot represent PPP. → decks 1, 2
2. **Check it independently.** Exact diagonalization at the same $N_t$ removes the Trotter error from the
   comparison, so any disagreement is a bug. Benzene and naphthalene agree with NSL. → deck 3
3. **Then make it fast.** The long-range $V$ makes the gauge action stiff. Exact Fourier acceleration
   removes that stiffness: 6–10× less CPU per independent sample for naphthalene and perylene at
   $\beta = 20$. → deck 4

Bugs met along the way, in NSL and in my own code, are collected in deck 5.

## Conventions used in all decks

$$
H = -\sum_{xy,\sigma}\kappa_{xy}\,c^\dagger_{x\sigma}c_{y\sigma}
  + \frac12\sum_{xy}V_{xy}\,q_xq_y ,\qquad
q_x = n_{x\uparrow}+n_{x\downarrow}-1 ,\quad
s_x = n_{x\uparrow}-n_{x\downarrow} ,\quad V_{xx}=U
$$

- Energies in units of $t$, $\beta$ in $1/t$, $\delta=\beta/N_t$.
- $\lambda_k$, $v_k$: eigenvalues and eigenvectors of $V$, $k=0$ the largest (perylene: $\lambda=0.87\ldots20.7\,t$).
- Benchmark and production parameters: screened Ohno, $t=2.4$ eV, $U=8$ eV ($U/t=3.33$),
  $\epsilon=2$, bond length 1.4 Å.
- Field `phi` has shape $(N_t, N_x)$; matrices act from the right, $\phi_t^T A \to$ `phi.matmul(A)`.

## Terms used in the notes (1): model and ED

Several of these are my own labels, not established terminology.

| term | meaning | deck |
|----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|------|
| charge basis / spin basis | auxiliary field coupled to $q_x$ (`HubbardExp`, $e^{i\phi}$) or to $s_x$ (`HubbardExpSpinBasis`, $e^{\phi}$) | 1, 2 |
| screened Ohno, MN | $V_{xy}=U/\sqrt{1+(U\epsilon r/e^2)^2}$; Mataga–Nishimoto $U/(1+U\epsilon r/e^2)$ | 1 |
| $S_g$, $S_f$ | gauge action $\frac12\sum_t\phi_t^T(\delta V)^{-1}\phi_t$; fermion action $S-S_g=-\log(\det M_p\det M_h)$ | 1, 4 |
| plain mode | driver with `HMC: autotune: false`: fixed $N_\text{md}$, all trajectories in one process | 1 |
| sector $(N_\uparrow,N_\downarrow)$ | block of the Fock space with fixed particle numbers; $H$ and $W$ are block diagonal | 3 |
| dense / low-lying backend | ED by full diagonalization of every sector / by Lanczos for only the states that contribute above `tol` | 3 |
| deterministic check | NSL's stored `invM` against a dense numpy inverse of the same configuration | 3 |
| distance classes | site pairs $(x,y)$ at equal distance; $G$ is averaged over each class for the χ² | 3 |

## Terms used in the notes (2): HMC and analysis

| term | meaning | deck |
|----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|------|
| mode amplitude $a_k$ | time-summed field along $v_k$, $a_k=\sum_t\phi_t\cdot v_k/\sqrt{N_t\delta\lambda_k}$; $\langle a_k^2\rangle=1$ without fermions | 4 |
| uniform charge mode $a_0$ | $v_0$ is 98.7 % $(1,\dots,1)/\sqrt{N_x}$ and couples to the total charge; slowest mode for the leapfrog | 4 |
| staggered mode | $v_{N_x-1}$, mostly $\pm$ on the two sublattices; smallest $\lambda$, stiffest mode | 4 |
| $\omega_k$ | molecular-dynamics frequency of mode $k$: $(\delta\lambda_k)^{-1/2}$ with unit mass, 1 with EFA | 4 |
| stiff | mode frequencies spread over a wide range (perylene: factor 4.9) | 4 |
| EFA; $R$, $K$ | exact Fourier acceleration; exact rotation of the Gaussian part, kick by the fermion force | 4 |
| Γ method, binned $\tau$ | $\tau_\text{int}$ with Wolff's automatic window; $\tau$ from bin variances, which also sees slow tails | 4 |
| excursion | a stretch of hundreds to ≈ 2000 trajectories at larger $S_f$, seen with every integrator | 4 |
| $G(n)$ | site-averaged particle propagator at $n$ time slices | 4 |
| node, sign region | hypersurface in field space where $D=e^{-i\sum\phi/2}\det M_p$ (real) vanishes; region of fixed sign of $D$ | 7 |
| bridge link; $\Lambda$ | sampling $w\Lambda$ instead of $w$ and reweighting by $1/\Lambda$, $\Lambda=\frac1{2N_x}\sum_{i,x=\pm1}\lvert\det M_p(\phi+\theta x e_{b,i})\rvert^2/\lvert\det M_p(\phi)\rvert^2$ | 7 |
| sticking | many consecutive rejected trajectories at one configuration, near a node | 7 |
| multi-slice bridge; $\Lambda_\mathrm{all}$ | the bridge operator averaged over all time slices, $2N_xN_t$ terms; at $\theta=\pi/2$, $\Lambda_\mathrm{all}(\phi)$ is the configuration's local moment | 7 |

## Rendering

```sh
cd Executables/PPP/notes
quarto render                      # all decks → _slides/*.html
quarto preview index.qmd           # live preview
python3 scripts/make_figures.py    # only to rebuild images/
```

`_slides/` is in `.gitignore`. The figures in `images/` are PNG copies of `../figures/*.pdf` plus two new
plots (`gauge_modes_perylene.png`, `perylene_modes.png`) made by `scripts/make_figures.py`.
